description: Full structured PropertyCheck JSON (propertycheck/2) for one covered address: identity, coverage, capabilities, a summary and up to twelve sections, with status and source details where available. Call after check_address shows a full report is available. No account or API key is required for one-off purchase: x402 returns a standard PaymentRequired (A$1.39 incl. GST); retry the same call with params._meta['x402/payment']. Coverage is checked before any charge, an address outside coverage is never charged, and retrying with the same idempotency_key or the same payment never charges twice. If the user has no wallet, ask for explicit agreement to the A$4.95 card price, then call the same tool with payment_method='card'; give checkout_url only to the human and poll this same tool with the returned purchase_id and access_token. Never create a second checkout for that purchase. Existing B2B API-key accounts remain supported. After an API-key or x402 purchase, pass report_id instead of address to re-view the same report at zero cost; x402 re-view also carries the original payment proof. Optional sections limits the output; detail='full' restores heavy enumerations from the same stored report, with no second charge.

access_token.description: Private card-report retrieval token. Keep it inside the agent session and use only with its purchase_id.

address.description: One street address with number and suburb, e.g. "9 Hamilton Avenue, Surfers Paradise QLD 4217" or "222 Margaret Street, Brisbane City QLD 4000".

detail.description: Optional. standard (default) keeps all decision-useful facts; full also restores available heavy enumerations from the same stored report.

idempotency_key.description: Optional, API-key path. Reusing it returns the same report without a second charge.

payment_method.description: Optional for a new address. Default x402 (A$1.39). Use card only after the human explicitly agrees to A$4.95.

purchase_id.description: Private card-report purchase id returned by this tool. Poll with purchase_id plus access_token; do not send the address again.

report_id.description: An already purchased report to re-view at zero cost. Use address OR report_id, never both.

sections.description: Optional. Only these sections (identity, coverage, summary and sources are always included). Same price.

name: get_full_report
title: Get the full PropertyCheck report
